title: "M0-01: Module-bearing artifact identity"
format: html
---

**Feature ID:** `decide-module-out-of-survey-id` (historical ID retained).

**Owner:** `pipsystem` design record. `stamp` manages artifact versions.

**Git author:** R. Andres Castaneda. **Original recorder:** UNKNOWN.

## Decision

Keep the module in the internal artifact ID. The country, year ID, survey
acronym, and welfare type still identify the survey itself. A HIST-to-GPWG
switch gets a different artifact ID so it does not overwrite the old module's
history. The approved outcome rejects the module-free proposal in the feature ID.

**Inputs:** Survey identity, module name, and recorded module-version,
source-version, and data-type fields.

**Outputs:** A module-bearing ID with no version in it and separate `stamp`
version pins. Changes to those metadata fields require a new version within the
same ID, even when data values do not change. Historical reads must pair data
and metadata from the same version. Descriptive edits need not create versions.

## Check and gaps

**2026-11-25, pinned-record comparison: PASS.** Read the original and integrated
text with `git show`. The design keeps the module in the artifact ID and retains
the metadata-only version requirement and same-version historical pairing.

**Runtime: NOT RUN.** The exact save/read mechanisms are Open. The approval did
not select an alias, an identity migration, cross-module history machinery, or
forced saving of every unchanged object.
